title: STRATA corpus group entry
description: Documented contract for corpus/groups/<id>.yaml. This is the reference schema for the format; runtime validation is currently performed by the pydantic models in src/strata/normalize/models.py (see README for why: adding a jsonschema dependency for a second, redundant validation pass wasn't judged worth it for Week 2). Any change to this file should be mirrored in models.py and vice versa.

id.description: Lowercase slug, used as the group node's id in the graph. Must match the YAML filename's stem.

name.description: Display name, e.g. the Dragos-assigned group name in its canonical casing.

naming_org.description: Organization that coined this group's primary name.

ics_kill_chain_stage.description: ICS Cyber Kill Chain stage this group primarily operates at (1 = IT/enterprise intrusion and access development, 2 = OT-specific disruption/impact).

role.description: Free-text role description, e.g. 'initial_access_broker'. Not an enum -- new roles don't require a schema change.

hands_off_to.description: Handoff edges to other groups. A referenced group need not have its own corpus/groups/<id>.yaml file yet -- the loader stub-creates a bare node for it so the edge is still valid and cited.

citationId.description: Must resolve to a key in corpus/citations.yaml; the loader raises CitationNotFoundError otherwise.
